visualCharacteristics.purpose: Statische Filterleiste des Modellfinders: beschriftete Gruppen von Pill-Buttons (Antriebstyp, Modelle, Fahrzeugtyp) und eine Linkzeile
visualCharacteristics.layout: vertical stack in a ~230px left rail (filter-rail section), full width on mobile
visualCharacteristics.behaviour: non-functional: pills render as <button type="button" aria-disabled="true">, no filtering, no selected state
visualCharacteristics.icon: optional :charging: icon before a pill label

contentPattern.structure: group item: cell 1 label (text), cell 2 buttons (richtext ul, one li per pill); links item: one richtext cell with plain links
contentPattern.authoredIn: shared fragment /language-masters/de/fragments/model-filter, included via the fragment block

reuseGuidance: Author once in the shared fragment; place the fragment in a section with style filter-rail. Not a working filter.
